faqs.question: Which formats are supported?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPG and WebP. You can convert from any input image format to any of these three output formats.

faqs.question: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Everything is processed locally in your browser — your images never leave your device.
